findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite field is empty, so the base arm of the focused gate is not readable from the manifest's declared fields; it exists only as base-gate.log (revision fe057dcc5259a8ba801e863f5c63ae963eec59d3, 20 passed, EXIT=0). follow-on: the added test asserts that every claim has a resolvable citation and that the four hypothesis labels are exactly as expected, but it never ties receipt seed_bound_micro_ohm_m (the literal 0.9) to nova.imas.mast_seed_parameters.STAINLESS_STEEL.resistivity_upper, so the single number the entire adjudication turns on can silently drift from the module constant the receipt claims to describe; the guard would stay green through that divergence.

follow-on: the hotter-case hypothesis is the physically closest route to the ceiling and is left unsourced only because no fitted-shot can temperature is measured - the reference steel crosses 0.90 micro-ohm metre at about 415 K (142 C) and the module's own interval already spans room temperature to the 200 C designed bake. The actionable follow-on is therefore a can-temperature estimate (thermal model or thermocouple record) rather than further resistivity sourcing, because the receipt has already shown a higher-resistivity grade is undocumented. The run lists this, but the receipt framing points the next node at the weaker of the two directions.

justifications.durability: One test is added, test_coil_case_receipt_claims_have_citations, and it guards this node's substantive claim: that every receipt claim carries a citation resolving to a declared source and that all four hypotheses are adjudicated, with the negative control showing it fires (EXIT=1) when a citation is removed. It is a document-integrity guard rather than a numerical one, which is proportionate for a source-check node that changes no computation, but for that same reason it pins the receipt's structure and hypothesis set and cannot detect a wrong adjudication or a mistyped value, only a missing or dangling citation. Not higher because there is no measured behaviour in this node for the guard to falsify, and the receipt's central 0.90 anchor is not tied to the module constant it describes (see finding).
justifications.evidence: The receipt reproduces and its load-bearing claims survive independent checking. I re-ran the focused gate at the reviewed head ee164d5b7f25f137dfa71ad74ce0b1688d6c65e9 (21 passed, EXIT=0) and reproduced the negative control in a scratch tree (a citation stripped from the seed claim reddens test_coil_case_receipt_claims_have_citations, EXIT=1). I then independently verified the two literature claims against the cited primary sources rather than the run's summary: the NBS SRM 798 high-temperature fit rho = 154.1 T^0.0997 - 191.0 micro-ohm cm (rho in micro-ohm cm, T in kelvin) reproduces the receipt's 0.811, 0.890 and 0.923 micro-ohm metre at 300, 400 and 450 K and the ~415 K crossing of 0.90 micro-ohm metre within rounding, and the MAST magnetic-diagnostics paper states directly that the PF coils sit inside stainless steel cans supported from the vessel wall and are electrically connected to the vessel via both the mechanical support structure and the vacuum bellows connection of feeder bars, which is exactly the receipt's connections and parallel-path claim. Not 20 because the reviewed manifest's own baseline_suite field is empty, so the base arm is readable only from base-gate.log and not from the manifest's declared fields (see finding).
justifications.fit: The additions follow the file's and the repository's conventions: tests/test_mast_seed_parameters.py keeps its stdlib-plus-imports idiom (json and pathlib added beside the existing math and nova imports), the receipt lives under the established docs/figures/<node>/receipt.json convention shared by many sibling nodes, the fragment uses node-prefixed element ids and project-absolute src, and the commit carries a two-part message with a body. A label scan over the added lines finds no phase, stage, sprint, ticket or version identifier and no worktree path; the receipt keys on revisions and source locators rather than on plan identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node was dispatched to establish from independent sources whether the original MAST poloidal-field coil cans can carry an effective toroidal resistivity above the 0.90 micro-ohm metre bulk stainless bound the held-out fit saturates. Its documentary done-when asks for a citation-per-claim receipt under docs/figures/mast-coil-case-resistivity and an evidence fragment, adjudicating four hypotheses (higher-resistivity grade, temperature, toroidal insulating break, unmodelled parallel vessel path) as supported, refuted or unsourced, leaving nova/imas/mast_seed_parameters.py unchanged and nothing promoted if no independent source is found. The run delivers exactly that: receipt.json with 12 claims, 5 keyed sources and a citation on every claim; a fragment carrying the same four-row adjudication table; one hypothesis supported (the parallel vessel path is a documented topology) and three marked unsourced; the seed module untouched and no fit rerun. Not 20 because the section-4 question is answered only by exclusion: no independent resistivity source or break was found and no model extension was implemented, so the decisive physics now transfers wholly to a follow-on (a can-temperature or vessel-coupled model re-fit), which the run itself names.
justifications.reuse: The node changes no product source, so it introduces no duplicated machinery; it reads the seed ceiling from nova/imas/mast_seed_parameters.py (STAINLESS_STEEL.resistivity_upper 9.0e-7 ohm m, confirming the cited 0.90 micro-ohm metre bound) and its bespoke per-receipt check matches the existing pattern of tests that read one docs/figures receipt (test_production_solver_receipt_stamp, test_outboard_census_receipt_consistency). No shared receipt validator exists to reuse, so a local assertion is the available option. Not 20 because the receipt stores the seed bound as a literal (0.9) rather than importing the module constant it cites, so the one number the whole adjudication turns on is free to drift from its source.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff fe057dcc5259a8ba801e863f5c63ae963eec59d3 ee164d5b7f25f137dfa71ad74ce0b1688d6c65e9 is exactly three paths, all inside the reviewed manifest's declared write paths: docs/evidence/fragments/mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics/mast-coil-case-resistivity.html, docs/figures/mast-coil-case-resistivity/receipt.json, and tests/test_mast_seed_parameters.py. One commit, no out-of-scope source touched, no plan, sprint or index state mutated, and no worktree path in any changed file (the repository's pre-commit filepath guard would have refused one).
